editorial.blurb: Ali's Nihari & BBQ transports you to Karachi with authentic, slow-cooked curries and traditional Pakistani dishes that honor decades of culinary heritage.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Nali Nihari or Maghaz Nihari for the most authentic experience—the marrow and slow-cooked gravies are what define this place. Skip the mixed grill if you prefer deeply seasoned curries over lighter fare.
